facts.text: Jon is having trouble with his business project and is seeking advice on staying motivated during difficult times.

evidence.quote: I'm having trouble with my business project. Any advice on staying motivated even when times are tough?

facts.text: Gina suggests that Jon should focus on the big goal and why he is doing it, and also get help from people who support him to stay motivated.

evidence.quote: To stay motivated, I think of the big goal and why I'm doing it. I also get help from people who support me.

facts.text: Jon expresses feeling low on confidence and struggles with running his business due to a lack of self-belief.

evidence.quote: I've been feeling kinda low on confidence lately. It's hard to run a business when you don't have faith in yourself.

facts.text: Gina advises Jon to focus on his successes and progress, and to have faith in himself, emphasizing that confidence is important in business.

evidence.quote: I stay motivated by reminding myself of my successes and progress. It also helps to have a good support system. Just focus on why you started this – because you love it! Have faith in yourself, Jon.
